name: 30313 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30313 (Atlanta) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30313 (Atlanta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30313 (Atlanta) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
